domain_notes:
No domain-model change. This feature removes an undocumented cross-module composition dependency (balance -> leave-type, and the identical leave -> leave-type pattern) by giving the policy module its own composition factory, createPolicyService(), that wires PolicyService with its concrete collaborators (PgLeavePolicyRepository + LeaveTypeService(PgLeaveTypeRepository)). The change is composition-only: no service runtime behaviour, constructor signature, or public interface changes; no new cross-module import is introduced (balance/leave stop importing from ../leave-type and instead import createPolicyService from ../policy).

Domain impact: none. No new entities, attributes, relationships, lifecycle states, or business rules are introduced or altered. The existing domain model is unchanged:
- Entities and lifecycle states remain as documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: Employee (ACTIVE|TERMINATED|ON_LEAVE), LeaveType (static catalog, no lifecycle), LeavePolicy (DRAFT|ACTIVE|SUPERSEDED), LeaveRequest (DRAFT|SUBMITTED|APPROVED|REJECTED|CANCELLED), LeaveBalance (OPEN|CLOSED, inferred from periodStart/periodEnd vs now), AuditLog (RECORDED, immutable), Notification (PENDING|SENT|READ|ARCHIVED).
- The PolicyService -> ILeaveTypeService collaborator relationship (policy depends on leave-type through the public entry point to enforce that leaveTypeCode references an existing leave type) is unchanged in substance; only its construction site moves from balance/leave factories into the policy module's own factory.
- Binding business rules (requestedDays = endDate - startDate + 1 inclusive; sufficiency entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays >= requestedDays; reservation lifecycle; approval/cancellation authorization; role-scoped visibility; effective-policy uniqueness per leaveTypeCode; audit-on-state-change) are all unaffected.

No lifecycle states are introduced or renamed, so there is nothing new to fold into architectureMdUpdate beyond the composition-factory ownership note (which belongs to the application architect's module/dependency slice, not the domain slice).
